G3_failure_mode_and_recommendation: PROMPT-TEXT FACE-SUPPRESSION IS INSUFFICIENT. 'His face never enters the frame' does not keep a NAMED, described person's face out — the model frames the person it was told about, face included. This is the same failure family as negation-based suppression (you cannot instruct a thing away; you must frame/crop it away). To actually guard the boy's face out of Shot 3, the fix is COMPOSITIONAL, one of: (a) re-prompt S3 as a TIGHT MACRO on only the hands + shears + branch at a framing where no face physically fits (drop the word 'boy', describe only 'hands closing golden shears on the branch, tight macro, no face in frame' — but even 'no face' may not hold, so frame it out); (b) generate S3 at a low/over-the-shoulder or from-behind angle where the face is turned away; (c) deterministically CROP the existing S3 to the lower third (hands + branch) — a provenance-safe ffmpeg crop over the real frames that physically excludes the face, at 0cr, the crop-not-instruct approach applied to a person-guard. Option (c) can salvage THIS clip's Shot 3 without a re-generation. S1-S2, S4-S8 are strong and reusable; the kotinos turn (S7-S8) is exactly on-invariant.
